iq-moc-ooredoo-20260910.account: Iraq Ministry of Communications / Mustafa Sanad
iq-moc-ooredoo-20260910.title: Iraq and Ooredoo sign a Gulf-to-Europe internet-transit contract
iq-moc-ooredoo-20260910.summary: The official channel confirmed the ITPC-Ooredoo agreement. Public reporting targets activation in three to four months, while the marine-landing addendum and revenue share remain pending.
iq-moc-ooredoo-20260910.impact: International backbone, DWDM, border PoPs, security and low-latency operations move to L1. Validate scope and responsibility for the Kurdistan segment.

iq-moc-secure-lte-20260909.account: Iraq Ministry of Communications / Mustafa Sanad
iq-moc-secure-lte-20260909.title: Secure government LTE may expand to all public institutions with a 5G upgrade under review
iq-moc-secure-lte-20260909.summary: The minister discussed wider secure-government LTE coverage with Taurus Arm, including higher speed, performance and service security.
iq-moc-secure-lte-20260909.impact: Government private networking, secure core and unified operations form an L2 opportunity. Verify Taurus Arm's role, ownership and sanctions status first.

iq-cmc-ai-infra-20260910.title: CMC discloses plans for national AI infrastructure
iq-cmc-ai-infra-20260910.summary: CMC and the prime minister's AI adviser discussed specialised national infrastructure for AI workloads and advanced data processing.
iq-cmc-ai-infra-20260910.impact: Sovereign AI cloud, compute, storage, data-centre networking and security move to L2. Budget and procurement ownership are not yet confirmed.

iq-cmc-sim-drone-20260908.title: CMC reviews fraudulent-SIM controls, drone rules and a local mail service
iq-cmc-sim-drone-20260908.summary: CMC management discussed fraudulent SIMs, drone-related rules, a local mail service and delays affecting some Starlink equipment deliveries.
iq-cmc-sim-drone-20260908.impact: SIM governance, drone connectivity, mail platforms and satellite-terminal delivery belong on the regulatory watchlist pending formal rules or project documents.

iq-cmc-korek-20260906.title: CMC expands Korek location closures to three governorates
iq-cmc-korek-20260906.summary: Korek offices and service locations in Kirkuk, Nineveh and Salah al-Din were closed, extending enforcement across multiple governorates.
iq-cmc-korek-20260906.impact: Korek procurement, renewals, payments and service continuity move to red risk. Pause new unsecured exposure or obtain adequate protection.

jo-umniah-5g-202609.title: Umniah and Ericsson advance phase-two 5G and nationwide network expansion
jo-umniah-5g-202609.summary: The official release confirms continued capacity and performance upgrades, with enterprise cloud, data exchange and resilience as target capabilities.
jo-umniah-5g-202609.impact: Transport, indoor coverage, energy, automated operations and private networks offer follow-on opportunities; site count and investment value remain undisclosed.

jo-humain-ai-20260906.title: Jordan and HUMAIN sign an AI cooperation MoU
jo-humain-ai-20260906.summary: The framework covers skills, innovation and identification of scalable government AI use cases; it is not an awarded project.
jo-humain-ai-20260906.impact: Government AI discovery, sovereign cloud and model governance move to L2, pending budget, data accountability and procurement method.

jo-investment-license-20260910.title: Investment Ministry reiterates compliance-based licensing in development zones
jo-investment-license-20260910.summary: Eligible projects can start faster on a compliance declaration followed by inspection; the mechanism does not remove licensing or regulatory duties.
jo-investment-license-20260910.impact: Data-centre, cloud and software projects should verify eligible activities, development-zone conditions, post-inspection controls and foreign-investment restrictions.

lb-aoun-south-20260912.title: Aoun visits Nabatiyeh as southern site-access and network-restoration conditions come under pressure
lb-aoun-south-20260912.summary: The president travelled south with security chiefs while tension persisted around the Ali Taher ridge.
lb-aoun-south-20260912.impact: Southern telecom restoration needs site-level access confirmation, dynamic security, temporary recovery and force-majeure milestones.

lb-bank-law-20260910.title: Bank-restructuring Law 71 is published but remains subject to further legislation
lb-bank-law-20260910.summary: Bank reform advances, but public legal analysis says implementation still depends on financial-loss and deposit-recovery legislation.
lb-bank-law-20260910.impact: Do not treat banking payment capacity or project collections as normalised. Escrow, advance payment or guarantees remain necessary.

lb-media-law-20260909.title: New media law enters the Gazette, changing online-content and media-liability rules
lb-media-law-20260909.summary: The law improves some protections for journalists and online expression while retaining contested provisions on false or harmful news, insult and defamation.
lb-media-law-20260909.impact: Media, content platforms and corporate communications should update local publication, review and dispute-response checklists.
